lines: The other projections and assumptions previously disclosed by the Company regarding its net debt and leverage estimates, which do not include the effects arising from the acquisition of Arbex on July 1, 2026, remain unchanged, namely, that its net debt and leverage targets in U.S. dollars, expected to be reached over fiscal years 2027 and 2028, are, respectively: (a) US$11.0 billion and (b) below 2.5x.
